firm_data.firm_description: Bressler, Amery & Ross is a preeminent, full-service law firm driven to raise the bar and exceed client expectations in a full range of business and litigation services. Through a network of attorneys across multiple offices, they represent clients on a local, regional, national, and cross-border basis.
notable_facts: The firm has expanded its geographic presence.
The firm has a dedicated in-house Trial Support Department.
Bressler has joined the American Bar Association’s Well-Being Pledge & Campaign
Bressler Receives NJSBA 2025 Pillar of Justice Award for Exemplary Pro Bono Work Supporting Veterans
technology_signals: The firm has a dedicated in-house Trial Support Department comprised of technology professionals.
